visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man and a woman stand close together in a room with a heart-patterned white curtain. The man holds a silver smartphone, showing a video of another couple performing a physical lift. Both characters have neutral yet curious facial expressions, focusing intently on the device screen. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The man and woman turn their heads to face each other, talking and smiling broadly. The woman gestures with both hands, palms open, while the man points at himself and then at her. The background remains the simple domestic setting with soft lighting and a patterned curtain behind them. (3) The scene transitions to a brightly lit bedroom. The man, now wearing patterned black pajamas, stands over a bed with white sheets and a teal duvet. He attempts to lift the woman, who wears a pink sweater, over his shoulder. They both fall clumsily onto the bed, laughing. (4) The man removes his pajama top, revealing his bare torso. He tries to lift the woman again by grabbing her arm. She resists playfully with a wide smile. A small brown dog trots across the light-colored floor in the background. The man winces and rubs his shoulder in discomfort. (5) A close-up shot focuses on the man's bare upper back and shoulder. Three large, circular, dark purple bruises from cupping therapy are clearly visible. The man turns toward the camera with a strained, smiling expression while the woman, standing nearby, points at his back and laughs.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat pop music with a female singer plays at a moderate volume while a man and a woman speak in Mandarin. Their voices are calm, clear, and conversational. The background music features a steady four-on-the-floor beat with synthesizer pads and electronic textures. (2) The music abruptly cuts off, leaving only the room's natural acoustic environment. The man and woman engage in a playful verbal exchange in Mandarin. Their speech rate increases, and frequent bursts of melodic laughter from the woman are heard alongside the rustling sound of pajamas. (3) The audio environment is dominated by physical sounds such as a muffled thud as the couple hits the bed. The woman's laughter becomes more intense and higher in pitch. The man makes energetic efforts, his voice exhibiting strain as he shouts "Come on!" with high arousal. (4) The man makes a sharp, pained vocalization followed by a pained groan. The woman reacts with prolonged, high-pitched, and hysterical laughter that decays slowly. The sound of shifting fabric and quiet room tone remains as the video concludes with the woman's final giggles.
